title: Very good app
body: I really appreciate this app. Seems to do it all. Much cheaper to subscribe to than the biggest competitor. I would have rated it 5 stars except for a few small things: 1: It wouldn't translate Hebrew using the camera. It just gave gibberish. I sent an email to the developers with before and after pictures but didn't receive an answer. 2: The app's camera won't zoom. This makes it hard to translate things far away. 3: The conversation mode would be perfect if you didn't need to push the button before speaking. You pre-select the languages so the AI should be able to sense who is talking and automatically translate. If these things were fixed it would be 5 stars for sure.
